I get an error

trigger_conditions.pattern: Broadcasting Shape Preservation Failure During Graph Export
trigger_conditions.condition: Exporting models containing indexed buffers or tensors with singleton dimensions followed by broadcasting operations, where ONNX graph generation mishandles the original tensor shape semantics.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Exporting a module that registers a buffer with extra singleton dimensions, indexes the buffer, and adds it to an input tensor with larger spatial dimensions; e.g., buffer shape (1,1,3,1,1) indexed to (1,3,1,1), input shape (1,3,224,224).

failure_behavior.description: Exporting a module that registers a buffer with extra singleton dimensions, indexes the buffer, and adds it to an input tensor with larger spatial dimensions; e.g., buffer shape (1,1,3,1,1) indexed to (1,3,1,1), input shape (1,3,224,224).
